area.title: Area (Prefecture)
area.description: Prefecture to scrape. Use a keyword (tokyo, osaka, hokkaido, kanagawa...) or a code (SA11=Tokyo, SA23=Osaka...).

genre.title: Genre (Food Type)
genre.description: Food genre. Use a keyword (izakaya, ramen, yoshoku...) or a code (G001=Izakaya, G013=Ramen...).

maxItems.title: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of restaurants to collect (per area+genre).

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to crawl (1 page = 20 restaurants).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify proxy to avoid IP blocking.
